sanskrit: tvam a̍gne vrata̱pā a̍si de̱va ā martye̱ṣv ā | tvaṁ ya̱jñeṣv īḍya̍ḥ ||
english: Thou, O Agni, art the guardian of sacred rites among mortals, O god; thou art to be praised at sacrifices.

sanskrit: tvam a̍si pra̱śasyo̍ vi̱dathe̍ṣu sahantya | agne̍ ra̱thīr a̍dhva̱rāṇā̍m ||
english: Thou art praiseworthy at the assemblies, O conquering one; O Agni, thou art the charioteer of the ritual offerings.

sanskrit: sa tvam a̱smad apa̱ dviṣo̍ yuyo̱dhi jā̍tavedaḥ | ade̍vīr agne̱ arā̍tīḥ ||
english: So do thou, O Jātavedas, drive away from us the enemies, the godless malevolences, O Agni.

sanskrit: anti̍ ci̱t santa̱m aha̍ ya̱jñam marta̍sya ri̱poḥ | nopa̍ veṣi jātavedaḥ ||
english: The sacrifice of a mortal foe, even though near at hand, thou dost not seek out, O Jātavedas.

sanskrit: martā̱ ama̍rtyasya te̱ bhūri̱ nāma̍ manāmahe | viprā̍so jā̱tave̍dasaḥ ||
english: We mortals contemplate thy many names, O immortal Jātavedas; we the inspired sages.

sanskrit: vipra̱ṁ viprā̱so 'va̍se de̱vam martā̍sa ū̱taye̍ | a̱gniṁ gī̱rbhir ha̍vāmahe ||
english: We inspired sages invoke with songs the inspired god Agni, we mortals for aid and protection.

sanskrit: ā te̍ va̱tso mano̍ yamat para̱māc ci̍t sa̱dhasthā̍t | agne̱ tvāṁkā̍mayā gi̱rā ||
english: May a devotee draw thy mind even from the most distant abode, O Agni, with a song longing for thee.

sanskrit: pu̱ru̱trā hi sa̱dṛṅṅ asi̱ viśo̱ viśvā̱ anu̍ pra̱bhuḥ | sa̱matsu̍ tvā havāmahe ||
english: For thou art of like form in many places, lord over all peoples; we invoke thee in battles.

sanskrit: sa̱matsv a̱gnim ava̍se vāja̱yanto̍ havāmahe | vāje̍ṣu ci̱trarā̍dhasam ||
english: In battles we invoke Agni for protection, desiring prizes; him of brilliant bounty in contests.

sanskrit: pra̱tno hi ka̱m īḍyo̍ adhva̱reṣu̍ sa̱nāc ca̱ hotā̱ navya̍ś ca̱ satsi̍ | svāṁ cā̍gne ta̱nva̍m pi̱praya̍svā̱smabhya̍ṁ ca̱ saubha̍ga̱m ā ya̍jasva ||
english: For thou art the ancient one worthy of praise at the rites, and thou sittest as hotar both from of old and as the ever-new; satisfy thine own self, O Agni, and win good fortune for us.

sanskrit: ya i̍ndra soma̱pāta̍mo̱ mada̍ḥ śaviṣṭha̱ ceta̍ti | yenā̱ haṁsi̱ ny a̱triṇa̱ṁ tam ī̍mahe ||
english: That rapture most excellent at drinking soma which stirs in thee, O mightiest Indra, whereby thou smitest down the devourer — that we implore.

sanskrit: yenā̱ daśa̍gva̱m adhri̍guṁ ve̱paya̍nta̱ṁ sva̍rṇaram | yenā̍ samu̱dram āvi̍thā̱ tam ī̍mahe ||
english: Whereby thou madest the Daśagva tremble, Adhrigu, the heaven-man; whereby thou didst protect the ocean — that we implore.

sanskrit: yena̱ sindhu̍m ma̱hīr a̱po rathā̍m̐ iva praco̱daya̍ḥ | panthā̍m ṛ̱tasya̱ yāta̍ve̱ tam ī̍mahe ||
english: Whereby thou didst urge the great waters of Sindhu like chariots, to travel the path of Ṛta — that we implore.

sanskrit: i̱maṁ stoma̍m a̱bhiṣṭa̍ye ghṛ̱taṁ na pū̱tam a̍drivaḥ | yenā̱ nu sa̱dya oja̍sā va̱vakṣi̍tha ||
english: This hymn of praise for thine invocation, like purified ghee, O wielder of the stone — whereby thou hast now grown in strength on this very day.

sanskrit: i̱maṁ ju̍ṣasva girvaṇaḥ samu̱dra i̍va pinvate | indra̱ viśvā̍bhir ū̱tibhi̍r va̱vakṣi̍tha ||
english: Be pleased with this, O lover of praise; it swells like the ocean; O Indra, thou hast grown with all thy aids.

sanskrit: yo no̍ de̱vaḥ pa̍rā̱vata̍ḥ sakhitva̱nāya̍ māma̱he | di̱vo na vṛ̱ṣṭim pra̱thaya̍n va̱vakṣi̍tha ||
english: The god who has been entreated by us from afar for friendship, spreading wide like rain from heaven, has grown.

sanskrit: va̱va̱kṣur a̍sya ke̱tava̍ u̱ta vajro̱ gabha̍styoḥ | yat sūryo̱ na roda̍sī̱ ava̍rdhayat ||
english: His banners have grown, and the thunderbolt in his fists, when like the sun he caused the two worlds to grow.

sanskrit: yadi̍ pravṛddha satpate sa̱hasra̍m mahi̱ṣām̐ agha̍ḥ | ād it ta̍ indri̱yam mahi̱ pra vā̍vṛdhe ||
english: If, O great lord of the good, a thousand buffaloes have here been offered, then thy heroic power has greatly increased.

sanskrit: indra̱ḥ sūrya̍sya ra̱śmibhi̱r ny a̍rśasā̱nam o̍ṣati | a̱gnir vane̍va sāsa̱hiḥ pra vā̍vṛdhe ||
english: Indra burns down the afflicting one with the rays of the sun; like Agni in the forest, the victorious one has grown.

sanskrit: i̱yaṁ ta̍ ṛ̱tviyā̍vatī dhī̱tir e̍ti̱ navī̍yasī | sa̱pa̱ryantī̍ purupri̱yā mimī̍ta̱ it ||
english: This timely meditation goes forth ever newer; worshipping thee, the much-beloved one, she has truly measured out.

sanskrit: garbho̍ ya̱jñasya̍ deva̱yuḥ kratu̍m punīta ānu̱ṣak | stomai̱r indra̍sya vāvṛdhe̱ mimī̍ta̱ it ||
english: The embryo of the sacrifice, the god-devoted one, purifies wisdom in succession; Indra has grown through the hymns of praise, he has truly measured out.

sanskrit: sa̱nir mi̱trasya̍ papratha̱ indra̱ḥ soma̍sya pī̱taye̍ | prācī̱ vāśī̍va sunva̱te mimī̍ta̱ it ||
english: Indra has spread as the gaining of Mitra's prize, for the drinking of soma; like a cow lowing eastward for the presser, he has truly measured out.

sanskrit: yaṁ viprā̍ u̱kthavā̍haso 'bhiprama̱ndur ā̱yava̍ḥ | ghṛ̱taṁ na pi̍pya ā̱sany ṛ̱tasya̱ yat ||
english: Whom the inspired hymn-bearing Āyus have thoroughly delighted — he has swollen like ghee in the mouth, as is of Ṛta.

sanskrit: u̱ta sva̱rāje̱ adi̍ti̱ḥ stoma̱m indrā̍ya jījanat ||
english: And Aditi, the self-sovereign, has generated a hymn of praise for Indra — of much proclamation as his aids, as is of Ṛta.

sanskrit: a̱bhi vahna̍ya ū̱taye 'nū̍ṣata̱ praśa̍staye | na de̍va̱ vivra̍tā̱ harī̍ ṛ̱tasya̱ yat ||
english: The bearers have chanted for protection, for praise; the two bay steeds of the god are not of diverse ordinances, as is of Ṛta.

sanskrit: yat soma̍m indra̱ viṣṇa̍vi̱ yad vā̍ gha tri̱ta ā̱ptye | yad vā̍ ma̱rutsu̱ manda̍se̱ sam indu̍bhiḥ ||
english: When thou art exhilarated, O Indra, with Viṣṇu's soma, or with Trita Āptya's, or among the Maruts, together with the drops of soma —

sanskrit: yad vā̍ śakra parā̱vati̍ samu̱dre adhi̱ manda̍se | a̱smāka̱m it su̱te ra̍ṇā̱ sam indu̍bhiḥ ||
english: Or when thou art exhilarated, O mighty one, in the distant realm, upon the ocean — delight in our pressed soma together with the drops.

sanskrit: yad vāsi̍ sunva̱to vṛ̱dho yaja̍mānasya satpate | u̱kthe vā̱ yasya̱ raṇya̍si̱ sam indu̍bhiḥ ||
english: Or when thou art the strengthener of the presser, of the sacrificer, O lord of the good, or in whose hymn thou dost delight — together with the drops of soma.

sanskrit: de̱vaṁ-de̍va̱ṁ vo 'va̍sa̱ indra̍m-indraṁ gṛṇī̱ṣaṇi̍ | adhā̍ ya̱jñāya̍ tu̱rvaṇe̱ vy ā̍naśuḥ ||
english: We would praise Indra, Indra, the god over each god for your aid; then for the conquering sacrifice they have attained fully.

sanskrit: ya̱jñebhi̍r ya̱jñavā̍hasa̱ṁ some̍bhiḥ soma̱pāta̍mam | hotrā̍bhi̱r indra̍ṁ vāvṛdhu̱r vy ā̍naśuḥ ||
english: With sacrifices the sacrifice-bearing one, with soma the most excellent soma-drinker — Indra they have magnified with priestly recitations; they have attained fully.

sanskrit: ma̱hīr a̍sya̱ praṇī̍tayaḥ pū̱rvīr u̱ta praśa̍stayaḥ | viśvā̱ vasū̍ni dā̱śuṣe̱ vy ā̍naśuḥ ||
english: Great are his leadings forth, and many are his praises; all the good things have reached the worshipper fully.

sanskrit: indra̍ṁ vṛ̱trāya̱ hanta̍ve de̱vāso̍ dadhire pu̱raḥ | indra̱ṁ vāṇī̍r anūṣatā̱ sam oja̍se ||
english: The gods placed Indra in the forefront to slay Vṛtra; the holy voices chanted Indra together for strength.

sanskrit: ma̱hānta̍m mahi̱nā va̱yaṁ stome̍bhir havana̱śruta̍m | a̱rkair a̱bhi pra ṇo̍numa̱ḥ sam oja̍se ||
english: The great one with greatness — we with our hymns of praise, him who hears the invocation — we acclaim forward with songs for strength.

sanskrit: na yaṁ vi̍vi̱kto roda̍sī̱ nāntari̍kṣāṇi va̱jriṇa̍m | amā̱d id a̍sya titviṣe̱ sam oja̍saḥ ||
english: Whom neither the two worlds separated, nor the mid-air spaces, the thunderbolt-wielder — even from home his blazing radiance increases for strength.

sanskrit: yad i̍ndra pṛta̱nājye̍ de̱vās tvā̍ dadhi̱re pu̱raḥ | ād it te̍ harya̱tā harī̍ vavakṣatuḥ ||
english: When in battle-conflict the gods placed thee in the forefront, O Indra — then thy two beloved bays grew strong.

sanskrit: ya̱dā vṛ̱traṁ na̍dī̱vṛta̱ṁ śava̍sā vajri̱nn ava̍dhīḥ | ād it te̍ harya̱tā harī̍ vavakṣatuḥ ||
english: When thou didst slay with thy might Vṛtra who blocked the rivers, O thunderbolt-wielder — then thy two beloved bays grew strong.

sanskrit: ya̱dā te̱ viṣṇu̱r oja̍sā̱ trīṇi̍ pa̱dā vi̍cakra̱me | ād it te̍ harya̱tā harī̍ vavakṣatuḥ ||
english: When Viṣṇu strode out his three strides with might for thee, O Indra — then thy two beloved bays grew strong.

sanskrit: ya̱dā te̍ harya̱tā harī̍ vāvṛ̱dhāte̍ di̱ve-di̍ve | ād it te̱ viśvā̱ bhuva̍nāni yemire ||
english: When thy two beloved bays have grown day by day — then all the worlds have been held in order by thee.

sanskrit: ya̱dā te̱ māru̍tī̱r viśa̱s tubhya̍m indra niyemi̱re | ād it te̱ viśvā̱ bhuva̍nāni yemire ||
english: When the Marutic peoples have arranged themselves for thee, O Indra — then all the worlds have been held in order by thee.

sanskrit: ya̱dā sūrya̍m a̱muṁ di̱vi śu̱kraṁ jyoti̱r adhā̍rayaḥ | ād it te̱ viśvā̱ bhuva̍nāni yemire ||
english: When thou didst sustain yonder bright light, the sun, in the sky — then all the worlds have been held in order by thee.

sanskrit: i̱māṁ ta̍ indra suṣṭu̱tiṁ vipra̍ iyarti dhī̱tibhi̍ḥ | jā̱mim pa̱deva̱ pipra̍tī̱m prādhva̱re ||
english: This excellent praise of thine the inspired sage raises with meditations, nourishing a sister as with footsteps, before the rite.

sanskrit: yad a̍sya̱ dhāma̍ni pri̱ye sa̍mīcī̱nāso̱ asva̍ran | nābhā̍ ya̱jñasya̍ do̱hanā̱ prādhva̱re ||
english: When they have sounded together in unison in his beloved abode, at the navel of the sacrifice, the milch-cows, before the rite.

sanskrit: su̱vīrya̱ṁ svaśvya̍ṁ su̱gavya̍m indra daddhi naḥ | hote̍va pū̱rvaci̍ttaye̱ prādhva̱re ||
english: Bestow on us heroic power, good horses, and good cattle, O Indra — like the hotar for the first meditation, before the rite.

sanskrit: indra̍ḥ su̱teṣu̱ some̍ṣu̱ kratu̍m punīta u̱kthya̍m | vi̱de vṛ̱dhasya̱ dakṣa̍so ma̱hān hi ṣaḥ ||
english: Indra purifies wisdom worthy of recitation at the pressed soma-drinks; he is known for his growing power, for he is great.

sanskrit: sa pra̍tha̱me vyo̍mani de̱vānā̱ṁ sada̍ne vṛ̱dhaḥ | su̱pā̱raḥ su̱śrava̍stama̱ḥ sam a̍psu̱jit ||
english: He who is great in the first heavenly space, in the abode of the gods — he who crosses well, who has the highest fame, who conquers in the waters.

sanskrit: tam a̍hve̱ vāja̍sātaya̱ indra̱m bharā̍ya śu̱ṣmiṇa̍m | bhavā̍ naḥ su̱mne anta̍ma̱ḥ sakhā̍ vṛ̱dhe ||
english: Him I call for the winning of prizes, Indra, powerful, for the contest; be our nearest friend in thy grace, for growth.

sanskrit: i̱yaṁ ta̍ indra girvaṇo rā̱tiḥ kṣa̍rati sunva̱taḥ | ma̱ndā̱no a̱sya ba̱rhiṣo̱ vi rā̍jasi ||
english: This gift of thine, O Indra, lover of praise, flows from the presser; delighting in his sacred grass thou shinest forth.

sanskrit: nū̱naṁ tad i̍ndra daddhi no̱ yat tvā̍ su̱nvanta̱ īma̍he | ra̱yiṁ na̍ś ci̱tram ā bha̍rā sva̱rvida̍m ||
english: Now grant us that, O Indra, which we beg of thee who press the soma; bring us the bright wealth that wins the sun.

sanskrit: sto̱tā yat te̱ vica̍rṣaṇir atipraśa̱rdhaya̱d gira̍ḥ | va̱yā i̱vānu̍ rohate ju̱ṣanta̱ yat ||
english: When the all-discerning praiser has lifted up his songs beyond the arrogant — he who is pleased mounts like a branch.

sanskrit: pra̱tna̱vaj ja̍nayā̱ gira̍ḥ śṛṇu̱dhī ja̍ri̱tur hava̍m | made̍-made vavakṣithā su̱kṛtva̍ne ||
english: Like the ancient one, produce the songs; hear the call of the praiser; in each exhilaration thou hast grown for the well-doing one.

sanskrit: krīḻa̍nty asya sū̱nṛtā̱ āpo̱ na pra̱vatā̍ ya̱tīḥ | a̱yā dhi̱yā ya u̱cyate̱ pati̍r di̱vaḥ ||
english: His joyful truths play, like waters flowing downhill; through this meditation who is called lord of heaven.

sanskrit: u̱to pati̱r ya u̱cyate̍ kṛṣṭī̱nām eka̱ id va̱śī | na̱mo̱vṛ̱dhair a̍va̱syubhi̍ḥ su̱te ra̍ṇa ||
english: And he who is called lord, the sole sovereign of the settled peoples — with those who grow through homage, seeking aid, delight at the pressed soma.

sanskrit: stu̱hi śru̱taṁ vi̍pa̱ścita̱ṁ harī̱ yasya̍ prasa̱kṣiṇā̍ | gantā̍rā dā̱śuṣo̍ gṛ̱haṁ na̍ma̱svina̍ḥ ||
english: Praise the famous, wise one, whose two bay horses are victorious, who go to the house of the worshipper, bowing down.

sanskrit: tū̱tu̱jā̱no ma̍hema̱te 'śve̍bhiḥ pruṣi̱tapsu̍bhiḥ | ā yā̍hi ya̱jñam ā̱śubhi̱ḥ śam id dhi te̍ ||
english: Hastening, O great-minded one, with horses of sprinkled forms — come to the sacrifice with swift ones; indeed it is well for thee.

sanskrit: indra̍ śaviṣṭha satpate ra̱yiṁ gṛ̱ṇatsu̍ dhāraya | śrava̍ḥ sū̱ribhyo̍ a̱mṛta̍ṁ vasutva̱nam ||
english: O Indra, mightiest lord of the good, hold wealth among those who praise thee; undying fame rich in goods for the patrons.

sanskrit: have̍ tvā̱ sūra̱ udi̍te̱ have̍ ma̱dhyaṁdi̍ne di̱vaḥ | ju̱ṣā̱ṇa i̍ndra̱ sapti̍bhir na̱ ā ga̍hi ||
english: I call thee at sunrise, I call thee at noon of day; be pleased, O Indra, come to us with thy steeds.

sanskrit: ā tū ga̍hi̱ pra tu dra̍va̱ matsvā̍ su̱tasya̱ goma̍taḥ | tantu̍ṁ tanuṣva pū̱rvyaṁ yathā̍ vi̱de ||
english: Come now, run forward, be exhilarated with the pressed soma mixed with milk; extend the ancient thread as it is known.

sanskrit: yac cha̱krāsi̍ parā̱vati̱ yad a̍rvā̱vati̍ vṛtrahan | yad vā̍ samu̱dre andha̍so 'vi̱ted a̍si ||
english: Whether thou art in the distant realm, whether in the near realm, O Vṛtra-slayer, or whether thou art near the soma in the ocean.

sanskrit: indra̍ṁ vardhantu no̱ gira̱ indra̍ṁ su̱tāsa̱ inda̍vaḥ | indre̍ ha̱viṣma̍tī̱r viśo̍ arāṇiṣuḥ ||
english: May our songs magnify Indra, may the pressed soma-drops magnify Indra; the oblation-bearing peoples have rejoiced in Indra.

sanskrit: tam id viprā̍ ava̱syava̍ḥ pra̱vatva̍tībhir ū̱tibhi̍ḥ | indra̍ṁ kṣo̱ṇīr a̍vardhayan va̱yā i̍va ||
english: Him indeed the inspired sages, seeking aid, with their downward-flowing aids — the settled peoples magnified Indra like branches.

sanskrit: trika̍drukeṣu̱ ceta̍naṁ de̱vāso̍ ya̱jñam a̍tnata | tam id va̍rdhantu no̱ gira̍ḥ sa̱dāvṛ̍dham ||
english: At the three soma-vats the gods have fashioned the perceptible sacrifice; may our songs magnify him who ever grows.

sanskrit: sto̱tā yat te̱ anu̍vrata u̱kthāny ṛ̍tu̱thā da̱dhe | śuci̍ḥ pāva̱ka u̍cyate̱ so adbhu̍taḥ ||
english: When the praiser devoted to thee has placed the recitations in proper order, he is called pure and purifying — that one is marvellous.

sanskrit: tad id ru̱drasya̍ cetati ya̱hvam pra̱tneṣu̱ dhāma̍su | mano̱ yatrā̱ vi tad da̱dhur vice̍tasaḥ ||
english: That great ancient thing of Rudra stirs in the primeval abodes, where the discerning ones have separately placed the mind.

sanskrit: yadi̍ me sa̱khyam ā̱vara̍ i̱masya̍ pā̱hy andha̍saḥ | yena̱ viśvā̱ ati̱ dviṣo̱ atā̍rima ||
english: If thou art near in friendship to me, protect this soma; whereby we have crossed beyond all enemies.

sanskrit: ka̱dā ta̍ indra girvaṇaḥ sto̱tā bha̍vāti̱ śaṁta̍maḥ | ka̱dā no̱ gavye̱ aśvye̱ vasau̍ dadhaḥ ||
english: When, O Indra, lover of praise, will the praiser be most blessed? When wilt thou place us in wealth of cattle and horses?

sanskrit: u̱ta te̱ suṣṭu̍tā̱ harī̱ vṛṣa̍ṇā vahato̱ ratha̍m | a̱ju̱ryasya̍ ma̱dinta̍ma̱ṁ yam īma̍he ||
english: And thy well-praised, virile two bay steeds draw thy chariot, the most exhilarating of him who knows no old age, whom we implore.

sanskrit: tam ī̍mahe puruṣṭu̱taṁ ya̱hvam pra̱tnābhi̍r ū̱tibhi̍ḥ | ni ba̱rhiṣi̍ pri̱ye sa̍da̱d adha̍ dvi̱tā ||
english: Him the much-praised, the mighty, we implore with ancient aids; may he sit down on the beloved sacred grass, and then a second time.

sanskrit: vardha̍svā̱ su pu̍ruṣṭuta̱ ṛṣi̍ṣṭutābhir ū̱tibhi̍ḥ | dhu̱kṣasva̍ pi̱pyuṣī̱m iṣa̱m avā̍ ca naḥ ||
english: Grow well, O much-praised one, with aids praised by sages; kindle the swelling refreshment and turn it towards us.

sanskrit: indra̱ tvam a̍vi̱ted a̍sī̱tthā stu̍va̱to a̍drivaḥ | ṛ̱tād i̍yarmi te̱ dhiya̍m mano̱yuja̍m ||
english: O Indra, thou art near to the praiser standing thus, O wielder of the stone; from Ṛta I urge thy mind-yoked meditation.

sanskrit: i̱ha tyā sa̍dha̱mādyā̍ yujā̱naḥ soma̍pītaye | harī̍ indra pra̱tadva̍sū a̱bhi sva̍ra ||
english: Here yoke those two bay steeds who are gladdened together for the drinking of soma; O Indra, resound towards us with both thy riches.

sanskrit: a̱bhi sva̍rantu̱ ye tava̍ ru̱drāsa̍ḥ sakṣata̱ śriya̍m | u̱to ma̱rutva̍tī̱r viśo̍ a̱bhi praya̍ḥ ||
english: May they resound towards us, thy Rudras who have obtained glory; and the Marut-attended peoples, with refreshment.

sanskrit: i̱mā a̍sya̱ pratū̍rtayaḥ pa̱daṁ ju̍ṣanta̱ yad di̱vi | nābhā̍ ya̱jñasya̱ saṁ da̍dhu̱r yathā̍ vi̱de ||
english: These rushings forward of his enjoy the foot-place that is in heaven; at the navel of the sacrifice they have put together as is known.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ dī̱rghāya̱ cakṣa̍se̱ prāci̍ praya̱ty a̍dhva̱re | mimī̍te ya̱jñam ā̍nu̱ṣag vi̱cakṣya̍ ||
english: This one goes eastward before the rite for the far-seeing eye; he measures out the sacrifice in succession, the far-seer.

sanskrit: vṛṣā̱yam i̍ndra te̱ ratha̍ u̱to te̱ vṛṣa̍ṇā̱ harī̍ | vṛṣā̱ tvaṁ śa̍takrato̱ vṛṣā̱ hava̍ḥ ||
english: Virile is this thy chariot, O Indra, and virile too are thy two bay steeds; virile art thou, O lord of a hundred powers, virile is the invocation.

sanskrit: vṛṣā̱ grāvā̱ vṛṣā̱ mado̱ vṛṣā̱ somo̍ a̱yaṁ su̱taḥ | vṛṣā̍ ya̱jño yam inva̍si̱ vṛṣā̱ hava̍ḥ ||
english: Virile is the pressing stone, virile the rapture, virile this soma now pressed; virile is the sacrifice which thou dost pervade, virile is the invocation.

sanskrit: vṛṣā̍ tvā̱ vṛṣa̍ṇaṁ huve̱ vajri̍ñ ci̱trābhi̍r ū̱tibhi̍ḥ | vā̱vantha̱ hi prati̍ṣṭuti̱ṁ vṛṣā̱ hava̍ḥ ||
english: As virile I invoke thee, the virile one, O thunderbolt-wielder, with brilliant aids; for thou hast desired the responsive praise — virile is the invocation.

sanskrit: yad i̍ndrā̱haṁ yathā̱ tvam īśī̍ya̱ vasva̱ eka̱ it | sto̱tā me̱ goṣa̍khā syāt ||
english: If I, O Indra, were as sole master of wealth as thou art, then my praiser would be a companion in cattle.

sanskrit: śikṣe̍yam asmai̱ ditse̍ya̱ṁ śacī̍pate manī̱ṣiṇe̍ | yad a̱haṁ gopa̍ti̱ḥ syām ||
english: I would teach him and would give to the wise man, O lord of śacī; if I were master of cattle.

sanskrit: dhe̱nuṣ ṭa̍ indra sū̱nṛtā̱ yaja̍mānāya sunva̱te | gām aśva̍m pi̱pyuṣī̍ duhe ||
english: Thy joyful truth, O Indra, is like a milch-cow for the sacrificer who presses soma; she milks out cow and horse, full and swelling.

sanskrit: na te̍ va̱rtāsti̱ rādha̍sa̱ indra̍ de̱vo na martya̍ḥ | yad ditsa̍si stu̱to ma̱gham ||
english: There is no turning away of thy bounty, O Indra — neither god nor mortal; when thou, being praised, art willing to give wealth.

sanskrit: ya̱jña indra̍m avardhaya̱d yad bhūmi̱ṁ vy ava̍rtayat | ca̱krā̱ṇa o̍pa̱śaṁ di̱vi ||
english: The sacrifice magnified Indra when he rolled the earth apart, fashioning a support in the sky.

sanskrit: vā̱vṛ̱dhā̱nasya̍ te va̱yaṁ viśvā̱ dhanā̍ni ji̱gyuṣa̍ḥ | ū̱tim i̱ndrā vṛ̍ṇīmahe ||
english: Of thee who hast grown, of thee who hast won all riches, we choose the protection, O Indra.

sanskrit: vy a̱ntari̍kṣam atira̱n made̱ soma̍sya roca̱nā | indro̱ yad abhi̍nad va̱lam ||
english: The bright lights overpassed the mid-air in the rapture of soma when Indra shattered Vala.

sanskrit: ud gā ā̍ja̱d aṅgi̍robhya ā̱viṣ kṛ̱ṇvan guhā̍ sa̱tīḥ | a̱rvāñca̍ṁ nunude va̱lam ||
english: He drove the cows upward for the Aṅgirases, making manifest those that were hidden in the cave; he thrust Vala towards him.

sanskrit: indre̍ṇa roca̱nā di̱vo dṛ̱ḻhāni̍ dṛṁhi̱tāni̍ ca | sthi̱rāṇi̱ na pa̍rā̱ṇude̍ ||
english: The bright lights of heaven have been made firm and established by Indra; the stable things he does not push away.

sanskrit: a̱pām ū̱rmir mada̍nn iva̱ stoma̍ indrājirāyate | vi te̱ madā̍ arājiṣuḥ ||
english: Like a wave of the waters exhilarating, the hymn of praise rushes swiftly towards Indra; thy raptures have shone forth.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hi sto̍ma̱vardha̍na̱ indrāsy u̍ktha̱vardha̍naḥ | sto̱tṝ̱ṇām u̱ta bha̍dra̱kṛt ||
english: For thou, O Indra, art the magnifier of hymns, the magnifier of recitations; and the well-doer for the praisers.

sanskrit: indra̱m it ke̱śinā̱ harī̍ soma̱peyā̍ya vakṣataḥ | upa̍ ya̱jñaṁ su̱rādha̍sam ||
english: The two maned bay steeds carry Indra to the drinking of soma, to the sacrifice rich in bounty.

sanskrit: a̱pām phene̍na̱ namu̍ce̱ḥ śira̍ i̱ndrod a̍vartayaḥ | viśvā̱ yad aja̍ya̱ḥ spṛdha̍ḥ ||
english: With the foam of the waters thou didst twist off the head of Namuci, O Indra, when thou didst conquer all adversaries.

sanskrit: mā̱yābhi̍r u̱tsisṛ̍psata̱ indra̱ dyām ā̱ruru̍kṣataḥ | ava̱ dasyū̍m̐r adhūnuthāḥ ||
english: Those who sought to escape by wiles, who sought to climb the sky, O Indra — thou didst shake down the Dasyus.

sanskrit: a̱su̱nvām i̍ndra sa̱ṁsada̱ṁ viṣū̍cī̱ṁ vy a̍nāśayaḥ | so̱ma̱pā utta̍ro̱ bhava̍n ||
english: The assembly of those who press not soma, O Indra, thou hast scattered in all directions, becoming superior as soma-drinker.

sanskrit: ā ga̍ntā̱ mā ri̍ṣaṇyata̱ prasthā̍vāno̱ māpa̍ sthātā samanyavaḥ | sthi̱rā ci̍n namayiṣṇavaḥ ||
english: Come here, harm him not, ye who go forward; pause not, O ye of equal wrath; even the firm things are bent.

sanskrit: yasya̍ dvi̱barha̍so bṛ̱hat saho̍ dā̱dhāra̱ roda̍sī | gi̱rīm̐r ajrā̍m̐ a̱paḥ sva̍r vṛṣatva̱nā ||
english: He whose great double-strong power has upheld the two worlds — with his virility, mountains, plains, waters, and heaven.

sanskrit: sa rā̍jasi puruṣṭuta̱m̐ eko̍ vṛ̱trāṇi̍ jighnase | indra̱ jaitrā̍ śrava̱syā̍ ca̱ yanta̍ve ||
english: Thou, the much-praised, dost reign alone; thou dost strike down the Vṛtras, O Indra, to attain conquering glories.

sanskrit: taṁ te̱ mada̍ṁ gṛṇīmasi̱ vṛṣa̍ṇam pṛ̱tsu sā̍sa̱him | u̱ lo̱ka̱kṛ̱tnum a̍drivo hari̱śriya̍m ||
english: That rapture of thine we praise, the virile one, ever victorious in battles, also the world-maker, O stone-wielder, beautiful with bay steeds.

sanskrit: yena̱ jyotī̍ṁṣy ā̱yave̱ mana̍ve ca vi̱vedi̍tha | ma̱ndā̱no a̱sya ba̱rhiṣo̱ vi rā̍jasi ||
english: Whereby thou hast found the lights for Āyu and for Manu — delighting in his sacred grass thou shinest forth.

sanskrit: tad a̱dyā ci̍t ta u̱kthino 'nu̍ ṣṭuvanti pū̱rvathā̍ | vṛṣa̍patnīr a̱po ja̍yā di̱ve-di̍ve ||
english: That same thing even today thy reciters praise as of old; conquer the waters whose lord is the rain-bull, day by day.

sanskrit: tava̱ tyad i̍ndri̱yam bṛ̱hat tava̱ śuṣma̍m u̱ta kratu̍m | vajra̍ṁ śiśāti dhi̱ṣaṇā̱ vare̍ṇyam ||
english: That great heroic power is thine, thine too is the impetus and the will; divine wisdom sharpens the desirable thunderbolt.

sanskrit: tava̱ dyaur i̍ndra̱ pauṁsya̍m pṛthi̱vī va̍rdhati̱ śrava̍ḥ | tvām āpa̱ḥ parva̍tāsaś ca hinvire ||
english: Heaven increases thy manliness, O Indra, earth increases thy fame; the waters and the mountains urge thee on.

sanskrit: tvāṁ viṣṇu̍r bṛ̱han kṣayo̍ mi̱tro gṛ̍ṇāti̱ varu̍ṇaḥ | tvāṁ śardho̍ mada̱ty anu̱ māru̍tam ||
english: Viṣṇu of great dwelling praises thee, Mitra praises thee, Varuṇa; the Marutic host is exhilarated after thee.

sanskrit: tvaṁ vṛṣā̱ janā̍nā̱m maṁhi̍ṣṭha indra jajñiṣe | sa̱trā viśvā̍ svapa̱tyāni̍ dadhiṣe ||
english: Thou art born the rain-bull, the most generous among peoples, O Indra; thou holdest all things of good offspring together.

sanskrit: sa̱trā tvam pu̍ruṣṭuta̱m̐ eko̍ vṛ̱trāṇi̍ tośase | nānya indrā̱t kara̍ṇa̱m bhūya̍ invati ||
english: Thou alone, O much-praised one, dost cut down the Vṛtras completely; no other power than Indra's is greater.

sanskrit: yad i̍ndra manma̱śas tvā̱ nānā̱ hava̍nta ū̱taye̍ | a̱smāke̍bhi̱r nṛbhi̱r atrā̱ sva̍r jaya ||
english: When thinking of thee, O Indra, many invoke thee for aid — conquer the sun here with our men.

sanskrit: ara̱ṁ kṣayā̍ya no ma̱he viśvā̍ rū̱pāṇy ā̍vi̱śan | indra̱ṁ jaitrā̍ya harṣayā̱ śacī̱pati̍m ||
english: Apt for our great dwelling, entering all forms — exhilarate Indra, lord of śacī, for victory.

sanskrit: pra sa̱mrāja̍ṁ carṣaṇī̱nām indra̍ṁ stotā̱ navya̍ṁ gī̱rbhiḥ | nara̍ṁ nṛ̱ṣāha̱m maṁhi̍ṣṭham ||
english: The praiser proclaims forward the universal king of settled peoples, Indra, ever new with songs — the man, the man-conquering, the most generous.

sanskrit: yasmi̍nn u̱kthāni̱ raṇya̍nti̱ viśvā̍ni ca śrava̱syā̍ | a̱pām avo̱ na sa̍mu̱dre ||
english: In whom all recitations delight and all desire for fame — like the impetus of waters in the ocean.

sanskrit: taṁ su̍ṣṭu̱tyā vi̍vāse jyeṣṭha̱rāja̱m bhare̍ kṛ̱tnum | ma̱ho vā̱jina̍ṁ sa̱nibhya̍ḥ ||
english: Him I invite with excellent praise, the chiefest king, in the contest the wisdom-bearing great prize-winner for his gains.

sanskrit: yasyānū̍nā gabhī̱rā madā̍ u̱rava̱s taru̍trāḥ | ha̱rṣu̱manta̱ḥ śūra̍sātau ||
english: Whose deep, full raptures are broad and rescuing — exhilarant in the winning of heroic prizes.

sanskrit: tam id dhane̍ṣu hi̱teṣv a̍dhivā̱kāya̍ havante | yeṣā̱m indra̱s te ja̍yanti ||
english: Him indeed they invoke as champion in the wealth-contests that are set out; those whose Indra it is, they conquer.

sanskrit: tam ic cyau̱tnair ārya̍nti̱ taṁ kṛ̱tebhi̍ś carṣa̱ṇaya̍ḥ | e̱ṣa indro̍ variva̱skṛt ||
english: Him indeed the settled peoples approach with swift acts and with deeds; this Indra is the maker of wide space.

sanskrit: indro̍ bra̱hmendra̱ ṛṣi̱r indra̍ḥ pu̱rū pu̍ruhū̱taḥ | ma̱hān ma̱hībhi̱ḥ śacī̍bhiḥ ||
english: Indra is brahman, Indra is the seer, Indra is many and much-invoked; great with great powers.

sanskrit: sa stomya̱ḥ sa havya̍ḥ sa̱tyaḥ satvā̍ tuvikū̱rmiḥ | eka̍ś ci̱t sann a̱bhibhū̍tiḥ ||
english: He is worthy of hymns, worthy of oblation, true, a warrior of many deeds; being alone he is all-conquering.

sanskrit: tam a̱rkebhi̱s taṁ sāma̍bhi̱s taṁ gā̍ya̱traiś ca̍rṣa̱ṇaya̍ḥ | indra̍ṁ vardhanti kṣi̱taya̍ḥ ||
english: With arkas, with sāmans, with Gāyatrī verses, the settled peoples — the dwelling places magnify Indra.

sanskrit: pra̱ṇe̱tāra̱ṁ vasyo̱ acchā̱ kartā̍ra̱ṁ jyoti̍ḥ sa̱matsu̍ | sā̱sa̱hvāṁsa̍ṁ yu̱dhāmitrā̍n ||
english: The leader forward to better things, the maker of light in battles — the ever-victorious one who has conquered enemies in battle.

sanskrit: sa na̱ḥ papri̍ḥ pārayāti sva̱sti nā̱vā pu̍ruhū̱taḥ | indro̱ viśvā̱ ati̱ dviṣa̍ḥ ||
english: He the protector shall carry us across in safety — the much-invoked Indra — beyond all enemies.

sanskrit: sa tvaṁ na̍ indra̱ vāje̍bhir daśa̱syā ca̍ gātu̱yā ca̍ | acchā̍ ca naḥ su̱mnaṁ ne̍ṣi ||
english: So thou, O Indra, with prizes and with favour and with a good path — lead thou us to grace.

sanskrit: ā yā̍hi suṣu̱mā hi ta̱ indra̱ soma̱m pibā̍ i̱mam | edam ba̱rhiḥ sa̍do̱ mama̍ ||
english: Come hither, for this soma is delicious to thee; O Indra, drink this; here is the sacred grass, my seat for thee.

sanskrit: ā tvā̍ brahma̱yujā̱ harī̱ vaha̍tām indra ke̱śinā̍ | upa̱ brahmā̍ṇi naḥ śṛṇu ||
english: Let the two maned bay steeds yoked by prayer carry thee, O Indra; hear our prayers.

sanskrit: bra̱hmāṇa̍s tvā va̱yaṁ yu̱jā so̍ma̱pām i̍ndra so̱mina̍ḥ | su̱tāva̍nto havāmahe ||
english: We the prayer-bearers with our ally invoke thee, O Indra the soma-drinker, we who possess soma, we who press the soma.

sanskrit: ā no̍ yāhi su̱tāva̍to̱ 'smāka̍ṁ suṣṭu̱tīr upa̍ | pibā̱ su śi̍pri̱nn andha̍saḥ ||
english: Come to us who press soma, to our excellent praises; drink well of the soma-juice, O thou of mighty jaws.

sanskrit: ā te̍ siñcāmi ku̱kṣyor anu̱ gātrā̱ vi dhā̍vatu | gṛ̱bhā̱ya ji̱hvayā̱ madhu̍ ||
english: I pour into thy two flanks; let it flow through the limbs; take the honey with thy tongue.

sanskrit: svā̱duṣ ṭe̍ astu sa̱ṁsude̱ madhu̍mān ta̱nve̱ tava̍ | soma̱ḥ śam a̍stu te hṛ̱de ||
english: Let it be sweet at the meeting, honey-sweet for thy body; may soma be beneficent to thy heart.

sanskrit: a̱yam u̍ tvā vicarṣaṇe̱ janī̍r ivā̱bhi saṁvṛ̍taḥ | pra soma̍ indra sarpatu ||
english: This one, O all-discerning one, wrapping thee around like women — may the soma glide forth, O Indra.

sanskrit: tu̱vi̱grīvo̍ va̱poda̍raḥ subā̱hur andha̍so̱ made̍ | indro̍ vṛ̱trāṇi̍ jighnate ||
english: Thick-necked, fat-bellied, well-armed in the exhilaration of the soma — Indra strikes down the Vṛtras.

sanskrit: indra̱ prehi̍ pu̱ras tvaṁ viśva̱syeśā̍na̱ oja̍sā | vṛ̱trāṇi̍ vṛtrahañ jahi ||
english: O Indra, go thou in front, being master of all by thy might; O Vṛtra-slayer, smite down the Vṛtras.

sanskrit: dī̱rghas te̍ astv aṅku̱śo yenā̱ vasu̍ pra̱yaccha̍si | yaja̍mānāya sunva̱te ||
english: Long be thy hook whereby thou dispensest wealth to the sacrificer who presses soma.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ ta̍ indra̱ somo̱ nipū̍to̱ adhi̍ ba̱rhiṣi̍ | ehī̍m a̱sya dravā̱ piba̍ ||
english: This soma, O Indra, is purified upon the sacred grass; come here, run to it, drink.

sanskrit: śāci̍go̱ śāci̍pūjanā̱yaṁ raṇā̍ya te su̱taḥ ||
english: O thou who art rich in śacī and honoured through śacī — this soma is pressed for thy delight, O Ākhaṇḍala, thou art invoked forward.

sanskrit: yas te̍ śṛṅgavṛṣo napā̱t praṇa̍pāt kuṇḍa̱pāyya̍ḥ | ny a̍smin dadhra̱ ā mana̍ḥ ||
english: He who is thy descendant, O Śṛṅgavṛṣa, the great-grandson, the one who drinks from the kuṇḍa vessel — in him thou hast fixed the mind.

sanskrit: vāsto̍ṣ pate dhru̱vā sthūṇāṁsa̍traṁ so̱myānā̍m | dra̱pso bhe̱ttā pu̱rāṁ śaśva̍tīnā̱m indro̱ munī̍nā̱ṁ sakhā̍ ||
english: O lord of the homestead, the firm post, the common feast of those rich in soma — the drop that shatters the ever-enduring forts, Indra the friend of the sages.

sanskrit: pṛdā̍kusānur yaja̱to ga̱veṣa̍ṇa̱ eka̱ḥ sann a̱bhi bhūya̍saḥ | bhūrṇi̱m aśva̍ṁ nayat tu̱jā pu̱ro gṛ̱bhendra̱ṁ soma̍sya pī̱taye̍ ||
english: Son of Pṛdāku, worthy of worship, seeking cows, being alone he exceeds the many; driving the impetuous horse with urgency, having seized the forts, he leads Indra to the drinking of soma.

sanskrit: i̱daṁ ha̍ nū̱nam e̍ṣāṁ su̱mnam bhi̍kṣeta̱ martya̍ḥ | ā̱di̱tyānā̱m apū̍rvya̱ṁ savī̍mani ||
english: Now indeed a mortal should beg the grace of these, the Ādityas' unrivalled favour in their power.

sanskrit: a̱na̱rvāṇo̱ hy e̍ṣā̱m panthā̍ ādi̱tyānā̍m | ada̍bdhā̱ḥ santi̍ pā̱yava̍ḥ suge̱vṛdha̍ḥ ||
english: For the paths of the Ādityas are unobstructed; their guardians are undeceived, who strengthen good growth.

sanskrit: tat su na̍ḥ savi̱tā bhago̱ varu̍ṇo mi̱tro a̍rya̱mā | śarma̍ yacchantu sa̱pratho̱ yad īma̍he ||
english: May Savitṛ, Bhaga, Varuṇa, Mitra, and Aryaman grant us that wide shelter which we implore.

sanskrit: de̱vebhi̍r devy adi̱te 'ri̍ṣṭabharma̱nn ā ga̍hi | smat sū̱ribhi̍ḥ purupriye su̱śarma̍bhiḥ ||
english: Come, O divine Aditi, with the gods, O thou of unharmed sustenance, with our patrons, O much-beloved one, with those of excellent shelter.

sanskrit: te hi pu̱trāso̱ adi̍ter vi̱dur dveṣā̍ṁsi̱ yota̍ve | a̱ṁhoś ci̍d uru̱cakra̍yo 'ne̱hasa̍ḥ ||
english: For those sons of Aditi know how to keep away enmities; they who are wide-wheeled, sinless, even from straits.

sanskrit: adi̍tir no̱ divā̍ pa̱śum adi̍ti̱r nakta̱m adva̍yāḥ | adi̍tiḥ pā̱tv aṁha̍saḥ sa̱dāvṛ̍dhā ||
english: Aditi, without duplicity, shall protect our livestock by day; Aditi shall protect it by night; Aditi, who ever grows, shall protect us from distress.

sanskrit: u̱ta syā no̱ divā̍ ma̱tir adi̍tir ū̱tyā ga̍mat | sā śaṁtā̍ti̱ maya̍s kara̱d apa̱ sridha̍ḥ ||
english: And may that thought, Aditi, come to us by day with aid; may she make well-being and joy, and drive away failures.

sanskrit: u̱ta tyā daivyā̍ bhi̱ṣajā̱ śaṁ na̍ḥ karato a̱śvinā̍ | yu̱yu̱yātā̍m i̱to rapo̱ apa̱ sridha̍ḥ ||
english: And may those two divine physicians, the Aśvins, bring well-being to us; may they drive away affliction and failures from here.

sanskrit: śam a̱gnir a̱gnibhi̍ḥ kara̱c chaṁ na̍s tapatu̱ sūrya̍ḥ | śaṁ vāto̍ vātv ara̱pā apa̱ sridha̍ḥ ||
english: May Agni with his fires bring well-being; may the sun warm us auspiciously; may the wind blow sinless and auspicious, driving away failures.

sanskrit: apāmī̍vā̱m apa̱ sridha̱m apa̍ sedhata durma̱tim | ādi̍tyāso yu̱yota̍nā no̱ aṁha̍saḥ ||
english: Drive away sickness, drive away failure, drive away ill-will; O Ādityas, keep us away from distress.

sanskrit: yu̱yotā̱ śaru̍m a̱smad ām̐ ādi̍tyāsa u̱tāma̍tim | ṛdha̱g dveṣa̍ḥ kṛṇuta viśvavedasaḥ ||
english: Drive the arrow away from us, O Ādityas, and also ill-will; make enmity go separately from us, O all-knowing ones.

sanskrit: tat su na̱ḥ śarma̍ yaccha̱tādi̍tyā̱ yan mumo̍cati | ena̍svantaṁ ci̱d ena̍saḥ sudānavaḥ ||
english: Grant us that shelter, O Ādityas, which releases; even the sinful from sin — O good givers.

sanskrit: yo na̱ḥ kaś ci̱d riri̍kṣati rakṣa̱stvena̱ martya̍ḥ | svaiḥ ṣa evai̍ ririṣīṣṭa̱ yur jana̍ḥ ||
english: Whoever among mortals seeks to harm us — let that man be harmed by his own people; may he be injured in his life.

sanskrit: sam it tam a̱gham a̍śnavad du̱ḥśaṁsa̱m martya̍ṁ ri̱pum | yo a̍sma̱trā du̱rhaṇā̍vā̱m̐ upa̍ dva̱yuḥ ||
english: Evil shall indeed befall that evilly-intending mortal, the enemy who approaches with deceit on our side.

sanskrit: pā̱ka̱trā stha̍na devā hṛ̱tsu jā̍nītha̱ martya̍m | upa̍ dva̱yuṁ cādva̍yuṁ ca vasavaḥ ||
english: O gods, ye are protectors of the simple; in your hearts ye know mortal man, both the deceitful and the non-deceitful, O Vasus.

sanskrit: ā śarma̱ parva̍tānā̱m otāpāṁ vṛ̍ṇīmahe | dyāvā̍kṣāmā̱re a̍smad rapa̱s kṛ̍tam ||
english: We choose the shelter of the mountains and the aid of the waters; keep calamity far from us, O heaven and earth.

sanskrit: te no̍ bha̱dreṇa̱ śarma̍ṇā yu̱ṣmāka̍ṁ nā̱vā va̍savaḥ | ati̱ viśvā̍ni duri̱tā pi̍partana ||
english: With your auspicious shelter, with your boat, O Vasus, carry us across all difficulties.

sanskrit: tu̱ce tanā̍ya̱ tat su no̱ drāghī̍ya̱ āyu̍r jī̱vase̍ | ādi̍tyāsaḥ sumahasaḥ kṛ̱ṇota̍na ||
english: For a weak offspring indeed — grant us a longer life to live, O Ādityas of great greatness.

sanskrit: ya̱jño hī̱ḻo vo̱ anta̍ra̱ ādi̍tyā̱ asti̍ mṛ̱ḻata̍ | yu̱ṣme id vo̱ api̍ ṣmasi sajā̱tye̍ ||
english: The sacrifice has been slighted among you, O Ādityas — be gracious; we are indeed close to you by kinship.

sanskrit: bṛ̱had varū̍tham ma̱rutā̍ṁ de̱vaṁ trā̱tāra̍m a̱śvinā̍ | mi̱tram ī̍mahe̱ varu̍ṇaṁ sva̱staye̍ ||
english: The great shelter of the Maruts, the divine protector, the Aśvins — we implore Mitra and Varuṇa for well-being.

sanskrit: a̱ne̱ho mi̍trāryaman nṛ̱vad va̍ruṇa̱ śaṁsya̍m | tri̱varū̍tham maruto yanta naś cha̱rdiḥ ||
english: Sinless, worthy of praise like a man, O Mitra, Aryaman, O Varuṇa — may the Maruts lead to us their triple shelter.

sanskrit: ye ci̱d dhi mṛ̱tyuba̍ndhava̱ ādi̍tyā̱ mana̍va̱ḥ smasi̍ | pra sū na̱ āyu̍r jī̱vase̍ tiretana ||
english: Though indeed we Manus are bound by death, O Ādityas — extend further our life to live.

sanskrit: taṁ gū̍rdhayā̱ sva̍rṇaraṁ de̱vāso̍ de̱vam a̍ra̱tiṁ da̍dhanvire | de̱va̱trā ha̱vyam ohi̍re ||
english: Him praised upward, the heaven-man, the gods have set in motion the divine fire-messenger; they have harnessed the oblation to the gods.

sanskrit: vibhū̍tarātiṁ vipra ci̱traśo̍ciṣam a̱gnim ī̍ḻiṣva ya̱ntura̍m | a̱sya medha̍sya so̱myasya̍ sobhare̱ prem a̍dhva̱rāya̱ pūrvya̍m ||
english: O inspired sage, praise Agni of broad bounty, of brilliant flame, the controller; O Sobhari, in this soma-offering, forward the ancient one for the rite.

sanskrit: yaji̍ṣṭhaṁ tvā vavṛmahe de̱vaṁ de̍va̱trā hotā̍ra̱m ama̍rtyam | a̱sya ya̱jñasya̍ su̱kratu̍m ||
english: We have chosen thee, the most sacrificing, the divine immortal hotar among the gods — the one of good will in this sacrifice.

sanskrit: ū̱rjo napā̍taṁ su̱bhaga̍ṁ su̱dīdi̍tim a̱gniṁ śreṣṭha̍śociṣam | sa no̍ mi̱trasya̱ varu̍ṇasya̱ so a̱pām ā su̱mnaṁ ya̍kṣate di̱vi ||
english: The son of strength, the much-blessed one, the well-shining Agni of best flame — may he win for us the grace of Mitra, of Varuṇa, of the waters, in heaven.

sanskrit: yaḥ sa̱midhā̱ ya āhu̍tī̱ yo vede̍na da̱dāśa̱ marto̍ a̱gnaye̍ | yo nama̍sā svadhva̱raḥ ||
english: The mortal who has served Agni with fuel, with oblation, with sacred knowledge — who with homage conducts the rite well.

sanskrit: tasyed arva̍nto raṁhayanta ā̱śava̱s tasya̍ dyu̱mnita̍ma̱ṁ yaśa̍ḥ | na tam aṁho̍ de̱vakṛ̍ta̱ṁ kuta̍ś ca̱na na martya̍kṛtaṁ naśat ||
english: His horses run swiftly as racers, his glory is most luminous; him no distress god-made from anywhere, nor man-made, shall reach.

sanskrit: sva̱gnayo̍ vo a̱gnibhi̱ḥ syāma̍ sūno sahasa ūrjām pate | su̱vīra̱s tvam a̍sma̱yuḥ ||
english: May we be of good fire through your fires, O son of power, O lord of strengths; thou art of good heroic might, well-disposed to us.

sanskrit: pra̱śaṁsa̍māno̱ ati̍thi̱r na mi̱triyo̱ 'gnī ratho̱ na vedya̍ḥ | tve kṣemā̍so̱ api̍ santi sā̱dhava̱s tvaṁ rājā̍ rayī̱ṇām ||
english: Being praised, a welcome guest like Mitra, Agni is like a chariot to be known; in thee good prosperities exist, thou art king of riches.

sanskrit: so a̱ddhā dā̱śva̍dhva̱ro 'gne̱ marta̍ḥ subhaga̱ sa pra̱śaṁsya̍ḥ | sa dhī̱bhir a̍stu̱ sani̍tā ||
english: That mortal who truly serves the rite, O Agni, is much-blessed, he is praiseworthy; through his meditations may he be a winner.

sanskrit: yasya̱ tvam ū̱rdhvo a̍dhva̱rāya̱ tiṣṭha̍si kṣa̱yadvī̱ra̱ḥ sa sā̍dhate | so arva̍dbhi̱ḥ sani̍tā̱ sa vi̍pa̱nyubhi̱ḥ sa śūrai̱ḥ sani̍tā kṛ̱tam ||
english: He for whose rite thou standest upright, the master of dwelling heroes — he achieves; he wins with swift horses, he with inspired men, he wins the deed with heroes.

sanskrit: yasyā̱gnir vapu̍r gṛ̱he stoma̱ṁ cano̱ dadhī̍ta vi̱śvavā̍ryaḥ | ha̱vyā vā̱ vevi̍ṣa̱d viṣa̍ḥ ||
english: He in whose house Agni would hold the form, the hymn, and the delight — or would pervade all the desirable oblations throughout the peoples.

sanskrit: vipra̍sya vā stuva̱taḥ sa̍haso yaho ma̱kṣūta̍masya rā̱tiṣu̍ | a̱vode̍vam u̱pari̍martyaṁ kṛdhi̱ vaso̍ vivi̱duṣo̱ vaca̍ḥ ||
english: Among the gifts of the inspired praiser, O son of power, O most swift one — make the word of one who knows above the mortal reach the gods, O Vasu.

sanskrit: yo a̱gniṁ ha̱vyādā̱tibhi̱r namo̍bhir vā su̱dakṣa̍m ā̱vivā̍sati | gi̱rā vā̍ji̱raśo̍ciṣam ||
english: Who serves Agni of good discernment with offerings of food, or with homage, or with song — him of swift flame.

sanskrit: sa̱midhā̱ yo niśi̍tī̱ dāśa̱d adi̍ti̱ṁ dhāma̍bhir asya̱ martya̍ḥ | viśvet sa dhī̱bhiḥ su̱bhago̱ janā̱m̐ ati̍ dyu̱mnair u̱dna i̍va tāriṣat ||
english: The mortal who has served Aditi with kindling at night-time with his abodes — may he, much-blessed with meditations, cross over all peoples with glories as if with flood-waters.

sanskrit: tad a̍gne dyu̱mnam ā bha̍ra̱ yat sā̱saha̱t sada̍ne̱ kaṁ ci̍d a̱triṇa̍m | ma̱nyuṁ jana̍sya dū̱ḍhya̍ḥ ||
english: Bring that glory, O Agni, which has overcome any devourer in the dwelling — the wrath of the people that is hard to deceive.

sanskrit: yena̱ caṣṭe̱ varu̍ṇo mi̱tro a̍rya̱mā yena̱ nāsa̍tyā̱ bhaga̍ḥ | va̱yaṁ tat te̱ śava̍sā gātu̱vitta̍mā̱ indra̍tvotā vidhemahi ||
english: That whereby Varuṇa sees, Mitra and Aryaman, whereby the Nāsatyas and Bhaga — we would serve thee in that, with power most knowing the way, protected by Indra's nature.

sanskrit: te ghed a̍gne svā̱dhyo̱ ye tvā̍ vipra nidadhi̱re nṛ̱cakṣa̍sam | viprā̍so deva su̱kratu̍m ||
english: Those indeed, O Agni, are of good thinking, O inspired one, who have placed thee, the man-watching one — the inspired ones, O god of good will.

sanskrit: ta id vedi̍ṁ subhaga̱ ta āhu̍ti̱ṁ te sotu̍ṁ cakrire di̱vi | ta id vāje̍bhir jigyur ma̱had dhana̱ṁ ye tve kāma̍ṁ nyeri̱re ||
english: They the altar, O much-blessed one, they the oblation — they have performed them in heaven; they have won great wealth with prizes, those who have laid their desire in thee.

sanskrit: bha̱dro no̍ a̱gnir āhu̍to bha̱drā rā̱tiḥ su̍bhaga bha̱dro a̍dhva̱raḥ | bha̱drā u̱ta praśa̍stayaḥ ||
english: Auspicious to us is the invoked Agni, auspicious is the gift, O much-blessed one, auspicious is the rite; and auspicious are the praises.

sanskrit: bha̱dram mana̍ḥ kṛṇuṣva vṛtra̱tūrye̱ yenā̍ sa̱matsu̍ sā̱saha̍ḥ | ava̍ sthi̱rā ta̍nuhi̱ bhūri̱ śardha̍tāṁ va̱nemā̍ te a̱bhiṣṭi̍bhiḥ ||
english: Make thy mind auspicious in the slaying of the Vṛtra, whereby thou dost conquer in battles; stretch out the firm things of the many who are haughty — we would win with thy aids.

sanskrit: īḻe̍ gi̱rā manu̍rhita̱ṁ yaṁ de̱vā dū̱tam a̍ra̱tiṁ nye̍ri̱re | yaji̍ṣṭhaṁ havya̱vāha̍nam ||
english: I praise with song him who is set in place by Manu, whom the gods have appointed as messenger and fire-envoy — the most sacrificing, the oblation-bearer.

sanskrit: ti̱gmaja̍mbhāya̱ taru̍ṇāya̱ rāja̍te̱ prayo̍ gāyasy a̱gnaye̍ | yaḥ pi̱ṁśate̍ sū̱nṛtā̍bhiḥ su̱vīrya̍m a̱gnir ghṛ̱tebhi̱r āhu̍taḥ ||
english: To Agni of sharp jaws, the young one who shines, thou singest refreshment — he who fashions heroic might with joyful truths; Agni invoked with ghee.

sanskrit: yadī̍ ghṛ̱tebhi̱r āhu̍to̱ vāśī̍m a̱gnir bhara̍ta̱ uc cāva̍ ca | asu̍ra iva ni̱rṇija̍m ||
english: When Agni, invoked with ghee, carries the splendour both upward and downward — like an Asura his shining garment.

sanskrit: yo ha̱vyāny aira̍yatā̱ manu̍rhito de̱va ā̱sā su̍ga̱ndhinā̍ | vivā̍sate̱ vāryā̍ṇi svadhva̱ro hotā̍ de̱vo ama̍rtyaḥ ||
english: He who has sent forth the oblations, established by Manu, with his sweet-scented divine mouth — he who properly conducts the rite seeks the desirable things, the divine immortal hotar.

sanskrit: yad a̍gne̱ martya̱s tvaṁ syām a̱ham mi̍tramaho̱ ama̍rtyaḥ | saha̍saḥ sūnav āhuta ||
english: If, O Agni, I were thee and thou wert me, the mortal — then I would be the great friend, the immortal; O son of power, invoked one.

sanskrit: na tvā̍ rāsīyā̱bhiśa̍staye vaso̱ na pā̍pa̱tvāya̍ santya | na me̍ sto̱tāma̍tī̱vā na durhi̍ta̱ḥ syād a̍gne̱ na pā̱payā̍ ||
english: I would not give thee over to reproach, O Vasu, nor to wickedness truly; may neither my praiser be transgressing nor ill-placed, O Agni, nor the evil one.

sanskrit: pi̱tur na pu̱traḥ subhṛ̍to duro̱ṇa ā de̱vām̐ e̍tu̱ pra ṇo̍ ha̱viḥ ||
english: Like a well-tended son in his father's hall — may our oblation go forward to the gods.

sanskrit: tavā̱ham a̍gna ū̱tibhi̱r nedi̍ṣṭhābhiḥ saceya̱ joṣa̱m ā va̍so | sadā̍ de̱vasya̱ martya̍ḥ ||
english: With thy nearest aids I would follow thee with pleasure, O Vasu Agni; always a mortal of the god.

sanskrit: tava̱ kratvā̍ saneya̱ṁ tava̍ rā̱tibhi̱r agne̱ tava̱ praśa̍stibhiḥ | tvām id ā̍hu̱ḥ prama̍tiṁ vaso̱ mamāgne̱ harṣa̍sva̱ dāta̍ve ||
english: By thy will may I win, by thy gifts O Agni, by thy praises; thee indeed they call the wise guide, O Vasu; mine, O Agni, be exhilarated to give.

sanskrit: pra so a̍gne̱ tavo̱tibhi̍ḥ su̱vīrā̍bhis tirate̱ vāja̍bharmabhiḥ | yasya̱ tvaṁ sa̱khyam ā̱vara̍ḥ ||
english: He stretches forward through thy aids, O Agni, those rich in heroism, those bearing prizes — whose friendship thou dost maintain.

sanskrit: tava̍ dra̱pso nīla̍vān vā̱śa ṛ̱tviya̱ indhā̍naḥ siṣṇa̱v ā da̍de | tvam ma̍hī̱nām u̱ṣasā̍m asi pri̱yaḥ kṣa̱po vastu̍ṣu rājasi ||
english: Thy drop, dark-hued, bellowing in season, being kindled, is taken in the tip; thou art the beloved of the great dawns; thou dost reign in the abodes of nights.

sanskrit: tam āga̍nma̱ sobha̍rayaḥ sa̱hasra̍muṣkaṁ svabhi̱ṣṭim a̍vase | sa̱mrāja̱ṁ trāsa̍dasyavam ||
english: We Sobharis have come to him, the thousand-testicled one, of own conquest, for aid — to Trasadasyu the universal king.

sanskrit: yasya̍ te agne a̱nye a̱gnaya̍ upa̱kṣito̍ va̱yā i̍va | vipo̱ na dyu̱mnā ni yu̍ve̱ janā̍nā̱ṁ tava̍ kṣa̱trāṇi̍ va̱rdhaya̍n ||
english: Whose other fires, O Agni, dwell around like branches — the glories of inspired sages unite, magnifying thy dominions among the peoples.

sanskrit: yam ā̍dityāso adruhaḥ pā̱raṁ naya̍tha̱ martya̍m | ma̱ghonā̱ṁ viśe̍ṣāṁ sudānavaḥ ||
english: The mortal whom you Ādityas, the non-deceitful, lead to the farther shore — O good givers, to the especial goods of the generous.

sanskrit: yū̱yaṁ rā̍jāna̱ḥ kaṁ ci̍c carṣaṇīsaha̱ḥ kṣaya̍nta̱m mānu̍ṣā̱m̐ anu̍ | va̱yaṁ te vo̱ varu̍ṇa̱ mitrārya̍ma̱n syāmed ṛ̱tasya̍ ra̱thya̍ḥ ||
english: Ye are kings, conquering all settled peoples, dwelling among humans; may we be the charioteers of Ṛta, O Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman.

sanskrit: adā̍n me pauruku̱tsyaḥ pa̍ñcā̱śata̍ṁ tra̱sada̍syur va̱dhūnā̍m | maṁhi̍ṣṭho a̱ryaḥ satpa̍tiḥ ||
english: Trasadasyu, son of Purukutsa, gave me fifty female slaves — the most generous, the noble one, the lord of the good.

sanskrit: u̱ta me̍ pra̱yiyo̍r va̱yiyo̍ḥ su̱vāstvā̱ adhi̱ tugva̍ni | ti̱sṝ̱ṇāṁ sa̍ptatī̱nāṁ śyā̱vaḥ pra̍ṇe̱tā bhu̍va̱d vasu̱r diyā̍nā̱m pati̍ḥ ||
english: And to me, from among the two beloved and the two weavers upon Tugvan, of three times seventy — may Śyāva be the leader, the good one, the lord of the liberal givers.

sanskrit: ā ga̍ntā̱ mā ri̍ṣaṇyata̱ prasthā̍vāno̱ māpa̍ sthātā samanyavaḥ | sthi̱rā ci̍n namayiṣṇavaḥ ||
english: Come hither, harm not, ye who go forward; pause not, O ye of equal wrath; ye are the benders even of firm things.

sanskrit: vī̱ḻu̱pa̱vibhi̍r maruta ṛbhukṣaṇa̱ ā ru̍drāsaḥ sudī̱tibhi̍ḥ | i̱ṣā no̍ a̱dyā ga̍tā puruspṛho ya̱jñam ā so̍bharī̱yava̍ḥ ||
english: With firm fellies, O Maruts, O Ṛbhu-lord, O Rudras of keen cutting — come to us today with refreshment, O ye much desired, O sons of Sobharī, to the sacrifice.

sanskrit: vi̱dmā hi ru̱driyā̍ṇā̱ṁ śuṣma̍m u̱gram ma̱rutā̱ṁ śimī̍vatām | viṣṇo̍r e̱ṣasya̍ mī̱ḻhuṣā̍m ||
english: For we know the fierce impetus of the Rudriyas, the active Maruts, of Viṣṇu's rushing, of those who send rain.

sanskrit: vi dvī̱pāni̱ pāpa̍ta̱n tiṣṭha̍d du̱cchuno̱bhe yu̍janta̱ roda̍sī | pra dhanvā̍ny airata śubhrakhādayo̱ yad eja̍tha svabhānavaḥ ||
english: They flew apart over the two islands; the two worlds, where evil omens abide, have yoked together; the bright-diademed ones drove the dry lands forward when ye, self-shining ones, shook.

sanskrit: acyu̍tā cid vo̱ ajma̱nn ā nāna̍dati̱ parva̍tāso̱ vana̱spati̍ḥ | bhūmi̱r yāme̍ṣu rejate ||
english: Even the unshaken things in your course resound — the mountains and the lord of the forest; the earth trembles at your marches.

sanskrit: amā̍ya vo maruto̱ yāta̍ve̱ dyaur jihī̍ta̱ utta̍rā bṛ̱hat | yatrā̱ naro̱ dedi̍śate ta̱nūṣv ā tvakṣā̍ṁsi bā̱hvo̍jasaḥ ||
english: For your going, O Maruts, the great heaven above has lifted up; where the men, of arm-strength, point to their own bodies the vigorous forms.

sanskrit: sva̱dhām anu̱ śriya̍m naro̱ mahi̍ tve̱ṣā ama̍vanto̱ vṛṣa̍psavaḥ | vaha̍nte̱ ahru̍tapsavaḥ ||
english: In accordance with their self-power, the men carry great glory, those of fierce appearance, mighty, of rain-form, of unerring form.

sanskrit: gobhi̍r vā̱ṇo a̍jyate̱ sobha̍rīṇā̱ṁ rathe̱ kośe̍ hira̱ṇyaye̍ | goba̍ndhavaḥ sujā̱tāso̱ i̱ṣe bhu̱je ma̱hānto̍ na̱ḥ spara̍se̱ nu ||
english: The hymn of the Sobharīs is anointed with cows, in the chariot, in the golden sheath; those who are kinsmen of cattle, well-born, for refreshment and enjoyment — the great ones, touch us now.

sanskrit: prati̍ vo vṛṣadañjayo̱ vṛṣṇe̱ śardhā̍ya̱ māru̍tāya bharadhvam | ha̱vyā vṛṣa̍prayāvṇe ||
english: Bring forward your oblations to the manly triumphant ones, to the virile Marutic host — the oblations to him who moves with the rain-bull.

sanskrit: vṛ̱ṣa̱ṇa̱śvena̍ maruto̱ vṛṣa̍psunā̱ rathe̍na̱ vṛṣa̍nābhinā | ā śye̱nāso̱ na pa̱kṣiṇo̱ vṛthā̍ naro ha̱vyā no̍ vī̱taye̍ gata ||
english: With the rain-steed, O Maruts, with the chariot of rain-form and rain-nave — like eagles among the winged ones, come freely, O men, for the enjoying of our oblations.

sanskrit: sa̱mā̱nam a̱ñjy e̍ṣā̱ṁ vi bhrā̍jante ru̱kmāso̱ adhi̍ bā̱huṣu̍ | davi̍dyutaty ṛ̱ṣṭaya̍ḥ ||
english: With the same anointing their golden ornaments shine brightly on their arms; the spears flash lightning.

sanskrit: ta u̱grāso̱ vṛṣa̍ṇa u̱grabā̍havo̱ naki̍ṣ ṭa̱nūṣu̍ yetire | sthi̱rā dhanvā̱ny āyu̍dhā̱ rathe̍ṣu̱ vo 'nī̍ke̱ṣv adhi̱ śriya̍ḥ ||
english: Those fierce ones, virile, of fierce arms — none has stretched himself over their bodies; firm are the bows, weapons on your chariots; upon your battle-fronts are glories.

sanskrit: yeṣā̱m arṇo̱ na sa̱pratho̱ nāma̍ tve̱ṣaṁ śaśva̍tā̱m eka̱m id bhu̱je | vayo̱ na pitrya̱ṁ saha̍ḥ ||
english: Whose fame, broad like a flood, the fierce name of the ever-present ones — one alone enjoys it, like ancestral strength of birds.

sanskrit: tān va̍ndasva ma̱ruta̱s tām̐ upa̍ stuhi̱ teṣā̱ṁ hi dhunī̍nām | a̱rāṇā̱ṁ na ca̍ra̱mas tad e̍ṣāṁ dā̱nā ma̱hnā tad e̍ṣām ||
english: Worship those Maruts, praise them; for of those roaring ones — we cannot exhaust their gifts, so great are they, so great their greatness.

sanskrit: su̱bhaga̱ḥ sa va̍ ū̱tiṣv āsa̱ pūrvā̍su maruto̱ vyu̍ṣṭiṣu | yo vā̍ nū̱nam u̱tāsa̍ti ||
english: Blessed with good fortune is he who has been in your former aids, O Maruts, at the dawnings — or who is such now.

sanskrit: yasya̍ vā yū̱yam prati̍ vā̱jino̍ nara̱ ā ha̱vyā vī̱taye̍ ga̱tha | a̱bhi ṣa dyu̱mnair u̱ta vāja̍sātibhiḥ su̱mnā vo̍ dhūtayo naśat ||
english: Or to whose oblations you, O prize-winning men, come for enjoying — may he attain your graces with glories and with winning of prizes, O ye who shake.

sanskrit: yathā̍ ru̱drasya̍ sū̱navo̍ di̱vo vaśa̱nty asu̍rasya ve̱dhasa̍ḥ | yuvā̍na̱s tathed a̍sat ||
english: Just as the youthful sons of Rudra, of the divine powerful one, desire the sky — so may it be in that way.

sanskrit: ye cārha̍nti ma̱ruta̍ḥ su̱dāna̍va̱ḥ sman mī̱ḻhuṣa̱ś cara̍nti̱ ye | ata̍ś ci̱d ā na̱ upa̱ vasya̍sā hṛ̱dā yuvā̍na̱ ā va̍vṛdhvam ||
english: Those Maruts, good givers, who are worthy and who roam in common with those who send rain — from here come to us also with a better heart; as young men grow ye strong.

sanskrit: yūna̍ ū̱ ṣu navi̍ṣṭhayā̱ vṛṣṇa̍ḥ pāva̱kām̐ a̱bhi so̍bhare gi̱rā | gāya̱ gā i̍va̱ carkṛ̍ṣat ||
english: With the newest song indeed, O Sobhari, praise the virile purifying ones with words; sing as one who ploughs like cattle.

sanskrit: sā̱hā ye santi̍ muṣṭi̱heva̱ havyo̱ viśvā̍su pṛ̱tsu hotṛ̍ṣu | vṛṣṇa̍ś ca̱ndrān na su̱śrava̍stamān gi̱rā vanda̍sva ma̱ruto̱ aha̍ ||
english: Those who are victorious, who must be called upon like fist-fighters at the hotars in all battles — worship today with song the shining virile ones of highest fame, the Maruts.

sanskrit: gāva̍ś cid ghā samanyavaḥ sajā̱tye̍na maruta̱ḥ saba̍ndhavaḥ | ri̱ha̱te ka̱kubho̍ mi̱thaḥ ||
english: Even the cows of equal wrath, O Maruts, are of one kin and one bond; the bulls lick one another in turn.

sanskrit: marta̍ś cid vo nṛtavo rukmavakṣasa̱ upa̍ bhrātṛ̱tvam āya̍ti | adhi̍ no gāta maruta̱ḥ sadā̱ hi va̍ āpi̱tvam asti̱ nidhru̍vi ||
english: Even a mortal, O dancer-heroes of golden breasts, comes forward to brotherhood; step forth to us, O Maruts; for always your kinship is firm with us.

sanskrit: maru̍to̱ māru̍tasya na̱ ā bhe̍ṣa̱jasya̍ vahatā sudānavaḥ | yū̱yaṁ sa̍khāyaḥ saptayaḥ ||
english: O Maruts, bring to us the Marutic medicine, O good givers; ye are friends, ye are steeds.

sanskrit: yābhi̱ḥ sindhu̱m ava̍tha̱ yābhi̱s tūrva̍tha̱ yābhi̍r daśa̱syathā̱ krivi̍m | mayo̍ no bhūto̱tibhi̍r mayobhuvaḥ śi̱vābhi̍r asacadviṣaḥ ||
english: Whereby ye protect Sindhu, whereby ye conquer, whereby ye serve Kṛvi — be of benefit to us with those auspicious aids, O ye of beneficent nature, O enemies of the hateful.

sanskrit: yat sindhau̱ yad asi̍knyā̱ṁ yat sa̍mu̱dreṣu̍ marutaḥ subarhiṣaḥ | yat parva̍teṣu bheṣa̱jam ||
english: Whatever medicine is in Sindhu, in Asiknī, in the oceans, O Maruts of good sacred grass — whatever is in the mountains —

sanskrit: viśva̱m paśya̍nto bibhṛthā ta̱nūṣv ā tenā̍ no̱ adhi̍ vocata | kṣa̱mā rapo̍ maruta̱ ātu̍rasya na̱ iṣka̍rtā̱ vihru̍ta̱m puna̍ḥ ||
english: Seeing all, ye carry it in your bodies — speak to us of that; forgive the sin, O Maruts, of the afflicted one; restore for us what has gone astray.
